policy: Keep native Standard weighted selection on ties or absent consistent evidence. Reuse contextual pool/top-score, role/followup, capability and component checks without loosening them; final own pick unchanged. Four continuation response models: Standard weighted/early, Standard top-ranked/late, Counter weighted/teamfight, Creative weighted/early. Each uses three native leaf strategy presets. Hidden enemy locks and opening are not inputs. An override requires no reduction in wins or worst NW and strictly higher mean NW in every response model, plus >=1000 mean NW gain across all 12 training cases. Sample qualified alternatives with native-score weights/temperature1.75; otherwise retain the original native draw exactly. Thresholds are hypotheses, not validated confidence or professional-player formulas. Only correction: evaluate forecast leaves with inferred enemy roles and inferred-role default items, matching the final optimizer input; hypothetical future role locks are not treated as fixed. All filters, response models, thresholds and random sampling unchanged. Diagnostic cases are excluded from confirmation.
optimization: Unchanged production optimizer adapter: 64 own strategies versus three presets, 100 native item candidates total, then strategy retuning. Fixed work budget/frozen time, not a live timing test. Exact-identical serialized final optimizer states and case seeds may reuse deterministic baseline optimization/evaluation; reused rows are marked and are not counted as new simulator executions.
evaluation: Separate seeded enemy strategy/eligible-role/default-order profiles. Exact optimizer training/default profiles excluded. Own selected items and strategy used. Full policy comparison with paired random streams, no diluted mixture. No tuning on these results or earlier test reuse as confirmation.
acceptance: Same 10000 stratified paired whole-draft bootstrap. Success lower one-sided 95% bound >= -0.005; severe-loss upper bound <= +0.005; first-pick and first-ban entropy estimates nonnegative, entropy sum positive with lower bound >=0. Severe loss means lose and signed NW <-20000. Passing only permits separate integration validation.
production: Unchanged pending evidence and live-flow validation. No scheduler or recurring AI work.
